TS-LUMORA-COVER-IMG.caption:
Most skincare brands I look at in Nigeria are selling out of their DMs.

Not by choice. The alternative was a website that costs more than a month of sales and still ends up looking like a template from 2016.

So I built what the alternative should look like.

Lumora Skin is a demo brand I made up. Twelve products, prices in Naira, pay on delivery in Lagos. You browse, you add to bag, and the order lands in WhatsApp already typed out. No card form, no account, no app to download.

The part I care about is underneath. It took about thirty minutes to dress, because the engine is a template I can reskin for any beauty brand with one config file and their own product photos. A website stops being a six-month project and starts being something you can have this week.

Every build gets checked before it leaves. 117 automated checks, desktop and mobile, all three pages. Two real problems still got past all of them and I only caught them by actually looking at the screenshots, which is a lesson I apparently need to keep learning.

Lumora is not a client. Nothing on it is for sale. It exists so a brand owner can see the thing instead of trying to imagine it.

Real skincare business, still taking orders in the DMs? Yours can look like this. Send me a message.

Skincare brand. Twelve products. Order lands in WhatsApp already typed out.

It is a made-up brand, not a client, and nothing on it is for sale. I built it so brand owners can see the thing instead of imagining it.

Selling skincare from your DMs right now? Yours can look like this. DM me.

TS-LUMORA-X2.caption:
Real business in Nigeria, no website yet?

I will build you a sample site. Free. Your actual products, your actual photos, live enough to send to a customer.

Not a mockup. A working store like this one.

Three a week is all I can do properly. Reply and tell me what you sell.

TS-LUMORA-X3.caption:
If you sell skincare in Nigeria, you know the problem.

Same four questions in your DMs every day. Is it good for oily skin. Do you deliver to PH. How much. Is it still available.

A store answers all four before anyone types. Built this one as a demo. Yours can look like it.

TS-LUMORA-X4.caption:
This whole store reskins from one config file. Brand, colours, fonts, copy, products. Change it, swap the images, different brand in thirty minutes.

117 checks run before anything ships. Two bugs still got past all 117. Tests tell you nothing broke, not that it looks right.
